translate.already_lang: No translation needed: the text is already in the target language ({lang}).
translate.already_ru: No translation needed: the text is already in Russian.
translate.email_what: Enter your email: the MyMemory limit becomes 50,000 characters a day.
translate.err_bad_answer: The translation service gave an unclear answer. Try again.
translate.err_free_over: Today's free translation has run out.
translate.err_google_api_off: The translation service is not enabled in the Google Cloud project (step 3 of the setup).
translate.err_google_bad_key: Google did not accept the key: check that it was copied in full.
translate.err_google_billing: Billing is not enabled in the Google Cloud project (step 2 of the setup).
translate.err_google_denied_check: Google denied access: check the key and the project.
translate.err_google_not_connected: Google is not connected yet: a Google Cloud key is needed.
translate.err_google_quota: Google: the project limit is exceeded.
translate.err_google_too_many: Google asks you to wait: too many requests.
translate.err_mm_bad_email: MyMemory did not accept the email: check that it is spelled correctly.
translate.err_mm_quota: The MyMemory daily limit without an email (5,000 characters) is used up. Enter an email: the limit immediately becomes 50,000 characters a day.
translate.err_mm_quota_email: The MyMemory daily limit (50,000 characters) is used up. It resets tomorrow. To avoid waiting: connect Google.
translate.err_mm_quota_email_wait: The MyMemory daily limit (50,000 characters) is used up. It resets in {wait}. To avoid waiting: connect Google.
translate.err_mm_quota_tomorrow: The MyMemory daily limit is used up: it resets tomorrow.
translate.err_mm_quota_wait: The MyMemory daily limit without an email (5,000 characters) is used up. Enter an email: the limit immediately becomes 50,000 characters a day. Without an email it resets in {wait}.
translate.err_no_connection: No connection to the translation service. Check your internet and try again.
translate.err_too_many: The translation service asks you to wait: too many requests.
translate.exhausted_small: Today's limit is used up: what is left is less than the shortest paragraph.
translate.google_step1: Sign in to Google Cloud with your Google account and create a project (any name, for example ClipSD).
translate.google_step2: Enable billing for the project: Google will ask for a bank card for verification. 500,000 characters a month are free; within that, no money is charged.
translate.google_step3: Enable the translation service: on the page, click “Enable”.
translate.google_step4: Create a key: “Create credentials → API key” and copy it. The key starts with “AIza”.
translate.no_text: No text found in the selected area.
translate.setup_what: The setup window opens with the “Connect Google…” button.
translate.skipped: Already in Russian, left as is: {n}
translate.skipped_lang: Already in the target language ({lang}), left as is: {n}
translate.too_big_full: The screen is too large to recognize at once: select a part (Ctrl+L).
translate.usage_google: Google: this month {used} of {limit} free characters, {left} left (as counted by ClipSD)
translate.usage_mm: MyMemory: today {used} of {limit} characters, {left} left (as counted by ClipSD; with an email 50,000 a day)
translate.usage_mm_email: MyMemory: today {used} of {limit} characters, {left} left (as counted by ClipSD)
